Reviewed 2026-11-23. GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf / CVE-2026-54285 concerns JavaScript npm @opentelemetry/core (opentelemetry-js < 2.8.0). https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf
OWASP 13.0.0 incorrectly correlates that JS-only vulnerability to multiple Java OpenTelemetry 1.68.0 modules (api, sdk, common, etc.) using the general vendor/product CPE. This rule suppresses ONLY this one CVE when matched against an io.opentelemetry Java Maven module at exactly 1.68.0. No other CVE is suppressed; no future Java versions are exempt. Java 1.68.0 API/SDK are aligned through the OpenTelemetry BOM. See also https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/ZOOKEEPER-5087
